Body Text: 4 BHK Villas @2.90 Cr* | 15 min from Whitefield.

Meet Shonan Purie Trehan, our architectural collborator since ANASA's inception. Together, we've been creating By The Hills in Assagao, By The Beach in Morjim, and By The Fields in Moira.

Great collborations happen when visions align, not when one party simply executes another's brief. From our first conversations, it became clear we were approaching luxury homes from the same philosophical place - architecture should serve life, not showcase ego.

Shonan brought two decades of proven excellence. Seven-time AD100 recognition. World Architecture Festival finalist-twice. 
A portfolio spanning continents, from 1600-bed hospitals to intimate cultural spaces. The kind of track record that doesn't need validation.

What made this collaboration work was mutual respect for what the other brings. Shonan's mastery of narrative-driven design that responds to context. ANASA's understanding of what families actually need in second homes. Her global architectural perspective meeting our deep knowledge of Goa's landscape and lifestyle.

The result is three projects that feel distinctly different because they respond to three distinct locations, yet share the same underlying intelligence. Architecture that honors Goa's heritage while refusing to be nostalgic. Homes built for how people actually live, not how developers think luxury should look.

This is what happens when an architect of Shonan's caliber and a developer with ANASA's vision collaborate as true partners.

Swipe to understand the force behind our architecture.

📍 RiverMist Resorts, Mudigere, Chikkamagaluru
One of the BEST getaways I’ve had in recent times
 •  The resort has four PRIVATE WATERFALLS inside the property, each one is sooo beautiful & peaceful - you can sit there for hours doing nothing♥️♥️
• Hidden in the hills of Mudigere, surrounded by coffee plantations & mountain views
• It’s like a mini tourist-city inside a resort 🏞️
• You don’t need to go anywhere else - the views, the food, the stay… everything’s here✨
• There’s a river crossing right at the entrance - such a fun & unique experience
• ⁠They have wooden cottages & luxury villas with river and mountain views, some with jacuzzis and sky showers
• ⁠The infinity pool overlooking the valley is just wow🤍
• ⁠The food & hospitality here feel like home. The staff is so warm & will literally keep checking if you’ve eaten enough
• ⁠They even have a 15-min “nature connect”, where they turn off all lights so you can just connect with nature - something I experienced for the first time and absolutely loved
• ⁠It’s also close to many offbeat & scenic places around Chikmagaluru like Rani Ghati, so there’s plenty to explore nearby too
• ⁠The nature walk here is another beautiful experience. The guides who take you are so knowledgeable.. they’ll tell you even the tiniest details about nature you’d usually ignore. It just makes you see how amazing nature really is
• ⁠Whether you’re planning a family trip, a romantic escape, or even a proposal - this place is perfect. They even set up riverside candlelight dinners on request 

💯 recommended from our side

Body Text:
Some places are built for holidays. And then there are places that slowly change the way you live.

Goa has always been that feeling, unhurried mornings, long light, sea air that stays with you even when you leave. But what if that feeling didn’t have to end when the trip does?

At Escala, that feeling is expressed through three very different residences, each shaped by its own landscape and way of living.

Ocean Cloud, Dona Paula is where the sea becomes part of your everyday view. Elevated and quiet, it’s designed for those who prefer privacy with uninterrupted ocean horizons.

In Aria, Calangute, life feels more connected and contemporary. Clean architecture, modern spaces, and a location that keeps you close to Goa’s most vibrant stretch.

Retirement Planning: A growing number of NRIs are securing "legacy homes" now to serve as their primary residence for a high-quality retirement.
